name: Sleek
tagline: Generate editable iOS and Android app designs from a prompt.
description: Sleek is an AI mobile app designer that turns text prompts or reference images into iOS and Android UI. Designs are editable on a visual canvas and export to Figma or to React/HTML with Tailwind CSS. It also exposes an API and agent skills so AI coding tools can generate app screens directly. It targets non-technical founders, product managers, and developers prototyping mobile apps.
insight: Ships agent 'skills' that let coding agents such as Claude Code and Cursor generate app screens directly.
edge: Mobile-first: designs native iOS and Android screens and exports to Figma or React + Tailwind, where most AI UI tools target web layouts.
